source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The attachment matcher returns the first matching AttachmentInfo, or undefined. It checks an escaped filename pattern and retains the equal-name/application-pgp-signature fallback that review rejected removing. A later consumer fetches bytes, can decrypt the data and then calls RNP verification. The RNP helper converts verifyDetached exitCode with logical not. Keep those steps separate: a filename or MIME-type match is not successful cryptographic verification. Current raw-message retrieval and file saving differ from the original patch, and exception cleanup and trust internals remain outside scope. No signature verification or disk I/O ran.
title: Finding a signature attachment is separate from verifying its bytes
